reason: The cited evidence shows DSC used for HEA phase transformations and melting (E2, E4) and neutron imaging for observing liquid-state behavior (E5, E7, E8), but no evidence demonstrates their simultaneous integration, the claimed accuracy levels, or volume change quantification by neutron imaging during melting. Key premises about the integrated system and its performance are unsupported.
premises: DSC can measure melting temperature, enthalpy, and entropy of fusion for HEAs with stated accuracy
Neutron imaging can quantify volume changes and melt morphology during melting
Simultaneous DSC and neutron imaging can be integrated into a single high-throughput system
The combined method reduces uncertainties inherent in high-temperature thermal analysis alone
The method is applicable to a broad range of single-phase HEAs
